_note: Adult reference ranges commonly used by Indian labs. A lab's own printed range is always preferred when present. scale_if_below: values under this are treated as x1000 (e.g. platelets written as 150 instead of 150000). exclude: words that mean a line is a different test (e.g. 'Mean corpuscular hemoglobin' is not Hemoglobin).

tests.name: Hemoglobin
tests.low_means: Anemia: fewer oxygen-carrying red cells. Common causes are iron, B12 or folate deficiency, or blood loss.
tests.high_means: Can occur with dehydration, smoking, lung disease or living at high altitude.

tests.name: Total WBC count
tests.low_means: Low white cells can occur with viral infections (including dengue), some medicines or bone-marrow problems.
tests.high_means: High white cells usually point to an infection or inflammation.

tests.name: Platelet count
tests.low_means: Low platelets raise bleeding risk; commonly seen in dengue and other viral fevers.
tests.high_means: Can follow infection, inflammation or iron deficiency.

tests.name: RBC count
tests.low_means: Fewer red blood cells, seen in anemia.
tests.high_means: Can occur with dehydration or lung/heart conditions.

tests.name: Hematocrit (PCV)
tests.low_means: Low share of red cells in blood, seen in anemia.
tests.high_means: Rising PCV with falling platelets is a warning sign in dengue; also seen in dehydration.

tests.name: MCV
tests.low_means: Small red cells, typical of iron deficiency.
tests.high_means: Large red cells, typical of vitamin B12 or folate deficiency.

tests.name: Neutrophils
tests.high_means: Often seen in bacterial infection.

tests.name: Lymphocytes
tests.low_means: Can occur with stress, steroids or some infections.
tests.high_means: Often seen in viral infections.

tests.name: ESR
tests.high_means: A general marker of inflammation or infection.

tests.name: C-reactive protein
tests.high_means: Inflammation or infection somewhere in the body.

tests.name: Fasting blood sugar
tests.high_means: 100-125 suggests prediabetes; 126 or more on repeat testing suggests diabetes.

tests.name: Post-meal blood sugar
tests.high_means: 140-199 suggests prediabetes; 200 or more suggests diabetes.

tests.name: Random blood sugar
tests.high_means: 200 or more with symptoms suggests diabetes.

tests.name: HbA1c
tests.high_means: 5.7-6.4% suggests prediabetes; 6.5% or more suggests diabetes.

tests.name: TSH
tests.high_means: Can mean an underactive thyroid (hypothyroidism).

tests.name: Total T3
tests.low_means: Can be seen in hypothyroidism or illness.
tests.high_means: Can be seen in hyperthyroidism.

tests.name: Total T4
tests.high_means: Can be seen in hyperthyroidism.

tests.name: Free T4
tests.high_means: Can be seen in hyperthyroidism.

tests.name: Serum creatinine
tests.high_means: Kidneys may not be filtering well; also rises with dehydration.

tests.name: Blood urea
tests.high_means: Can occur with dehydration, high protein intake or kidney problems.

tests.name: Uric acid
tests.high_means: Raises risk of gout and kidney stones.

tests.name: SGPT (ALT)
tests.high_means: Liver cell irritation: fatty liver, hepatitis, alcohol or some medicines.

tests.name: SGOT (AST)
tests.high_means: Liver or muscle injury; also rises in dengue.

tests.name: Total bilirubin
tests.high_means: Jaundice: liver problem, bile blockage or red-cell breakdown.

tests.name: Total cholesterol
tests.high_means: Raises long-term heart disease risk.

tests.name: LDL cholesterol
tests.high_means: 'Bad' cholesterol; raises heart disease risk.

tests.name: HDL cholesterol
tests.low_means: Low 'good' cholesterol raises heart risk; exercise helps.
tests.high_means: Usually protective.

tests.name: Triglycerides
tests.high_means: Linked to sugar/refined carbs, alcohol, diabetes and heart risk.

tests.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
tests.low_means: Below 20 is deficiency, 20-29 insufficiency. Causes bone pain, tiredness, muscle weakness.
tests.high_means: Very high levels usually come from too many supplements.

tests.name: Vitamin B12
tests.low_means: Can cause tiredness, numbness/tingling, memory problems and anemia. Common in vegetarians.
tests.high_means: Usually from supplements.

tests.name: Ferritin
tests.high_means: Inflammation, liver disease or iron overload.

tests.name: Serum iron
tests.high_means: Iron overload or recent iron tablets.

tests.name: Sodium
tests.low_means: Can cause confusion, weakness; seen with vomiting, diarrhea, some medicines.
tests.high_means: Usually dehydration.

tests.name: Potassium
tests.low_means: Can cause muscle weakness and heart rhythm problems; seen with vomiting/diarrhea.
tests.high_means: Can affect heart rhythm; seen in kidney disease.

tests.name: Calcium
tests.low_means: Can cause cramps and tingling; often linked to low vitamin D.
tests.high_means: Can cause thirst, constipation, kidney stones.
